objectiveContract.sharedDirectorNote: No file under main/src/components/spaceStation/ or main/src/game/spaceStation/ imports main/src/story/ux/*. The station derives its objective from milestones on every render instead of running the shared objectiveDirector enter/ready/progress/complete lifecycle, so the shared contract's health states, one-shot entry cues, and missing-marker handling do not apply here.
objectiveContract.clearSemantics: stationStoryObjective() returns null when step === 'complete' or when the required cell/vendor is absent; the HUD, prompt and 3D marker then unmount together
objectiveContract.changeSemantics: objective identity changes only when a milestone commit lands (registryRecorded -> issuer; bondedCellAcquired + inventory count > 0 -> depart; stationDeparted -> complete). Recomputed from durable stores, so a reload rebuilds the same step.
objectiveContract.markerMatchingNote: single active objective; the in-world marker is placed from objective.target and carries no text, so there is no label-parity check between marker and HUD
objectiveContract.feedbackEmissionsPerEntryNote: n/a — no entry cue is emitted; prompt visibility is level-triggered on distance <= reach, re-showing every time the player re-enters reach

healthStateMapping.idle: no objective derived (step complete, or the required cell/vendor is absent) — HUD, prompt and marker unmounted
healthStateMapping.ready: an objective is derived and its in-world marker is placed from objective.target
healthStateMapping.missing-marker: derived objective whose target cell or vendor cannot be resolved; the station returns null rather than showing a labelled marker

markerAndWorkOrderMap.enter: milestone story:ch11-docked recorded on arrival in the interior branch (docking complete)
markerAndWorkOrderMap.workOrderInputParity: work-order line names [F] only; touch player sees 'USE' on the prompt and '[F]' in the HUD
no key or input named in either work-order line
